params.name: status
params.description: Filter projects by status. Omit for active projects.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of active projects visible to the authenticated user. Use the optional status parameter to retrieve archived or trashed projects instead.
Creates a new Basecamp project with the given name and optional description. Returns the new project with a 201 Created status.
Returns the project with the given ID including its dock, which lists the tools enabled for that project.
Updates the name, description, schedule dates, or admissions settings for an existing project. Returns the updated project.
Moves the project with the given ID to trash. Trashed projects can be permanently deleted from the Basecamp web interface.
Returns a paginated list of all people visible to the authenticated user across the account.
Returns a paginated list of all people with access to the specified project.
Grants or revokes access to the project for specific people. Accepts arrays of person IDs to grant or revoke, or new person objects to create and invite.
Returns a paginated list of all people the authenticated user can ping (direct message) within the account.
Returns the profile of the person with the given ID.
Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user.
Updates profile fields for the currently authenticated user including name, email address, title, bio, location, and time zone.
Returns a paginated list of active project templates visible to the authenticated user. Optionally filter by status.
Creates a new project template with the given name and optional description. Returns the template with a 201 Created status.
Returns the project template with the given ID.
Updates the name and description of an existing project template.
Moves the template with the given ID to trash.
Starts the construction of a new project based on the given template. Returns a project construction object whose status can be polled until it transitions from "pending" to "completed".

params.name: constructionId
params.description: Unique identifier of the project construction job

items.docs: Returns the current status of a project construction job. Poll this endpoint until status changes from "pending" to "completed".

params.name: bucket
params.description: Filter to a specific project (bucket) ID.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of recordings of the specified type across all projects. Use the type parameter to specify the resource type (Comment, Document, Message, Todo, Upload, etc.).
Moves the recording with the given ID to trash. Works for any recordable resource type including messages, to-dos, documents, and comments.
Archives the recording with the given ID. Archived recordings are hidden from default views but remain accessible.
Restores an archived recording to active status, making it visible in default views again.

params.name: messageBoardId
params.description: Unique identifier of the message board

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of active messages in the specified message board. Messages can be sorted by created_at or updated_at.

params.name: messageBoardId
params.description: Unique identifier of the message board

items.docs: Creates a new message in the specified message board. Set status to "active" to publish immediately; otherwise the message is saved as a draft.
Returns the message with the given ID.
Updates the subject, content, or category of the specified message.
Returns a paginated list of active comments on the specified recording. Any resource that exposes a comments_url can have its comments listed via this endpoint.
Creates a new comment on the specified recording. All subscribers to the recording will be notified. Supports HTML-formatted content.
Returns the comment with the given ID.
Updates the content of the specified comment.

params.name: todosetId
params.description: Unique identifier of the to-do set

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of active to-do lists within the specified to-do set.

params.name: todosetId
params.description: Unique identifier of the to-do set

items.docs: Creates a new to-do list in the specified to-do set with the given name and optional description.

params.name: todolistId
params.description: Unique identifier of the to-do list

items.docs: Returns the to-do list with the given ID.

params.name: todolistId
params.description: Unique identifier of the to-do list

items.docs: Updates the name and description of the specified to-do list.

params.name: todolistId
params.description: Unique identifier of the to-do list

params.name: completed
params.description: Set to true to return completed to-dos.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of active to-dos in the specified to-do list. Set completed=true to retrieve completed items instead.

params.name: todolistId
params.description: Unique identifier of the to-do list

items.docs: Creates a new to-do in the specified to-do list. Supports assignees, due dates, start dates, and completion subscriber notifications.
Returns the to-do with the given ID.
Updates the content, description, assignees, due date, or other fields of the specified to-do.
Marks the specified to-do as completed and notifies completion subscribers.
Marks the specified to-do as incomplete, reversing a previous completion.
Changes the position of the specified to-do within its to-do list. Position is 1-indexed.
Returns the schedule with the given ID including its configuration and entry count.
Updates the schedule's configuration, including whether it should include due dates from to-dos, cards, and steps.
Returns a paginated list of active schedule entries in the specified schedule.
Creates a new schedule entry in the specified schedule. Requires a summary, start time, and end time.

params.name: entryId
params.description: Unique identifier of the schedule entry

items.docs: Returns the schedule entry with the given ID.

params.name: entryId
params.description: Unique identifier of the schedule entry

items.docs: Updates the summary, times, description, participants, or recurrence configuration of the specified schedule entry.
Returns a paginated list of active documents in the specified vault.
Creates a new document in the specified vault. Set status to "active" for immediate publication; otherwise it is saved as a draft.
Returns the document with the given ID.
Updates the title and content of the specified document.
Returns a paginated list of active file uploads in the specified vault.
Creates a new upload entry in the specified vault using an attachable SGID obtained from the Basecamp attachment API.
Returns the upload with the given ID.
Updates the description or base name of the specified upload.
Returns a paginated list of all active campfire chat rooms visible to the authenticated user.

params.name: campfireId
params.description: Unique identifier of the campfire chat room

items.docs: Returns the campfire with the given ID.

params.name: campfireId
params.description: Unique identifier of the campfire chat room

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of chat messages (lines) in the specified campfire, ordered newest first.

params.name: campfireId
params.description: Unique identifier of the campfire chat room

items.docs: Posts a new message to the specified campfire. Content must be plain text.

params.name: campfireId
params.description: Unique identifier of the campfire chat room

params.name: lineId
params.description: Unique identifier of the campfire line

items.docs: Returns the specific campfire line with the given ID.

params.name: campfireId
params.description: Unique identifier of the campfire chat room

params.name: lineId
params.description: Unique identifier of the campfire line

items.docs: Deletes the campfire line with the given ID. Only the line creator or account admins can delete lines.

params.name: cardTableId
params.description: Unique identifier of the card table

items.docs: Returns the card table with the given ID, including its columns and metadata such as card counts per column.

params.name: cardTableId
params.description: Unique identifier of the card table

items.docs: Moves a card to a different column on the card table at the specified zero-indexed position.
Returns all webhooks configured for the project with the given ID, including delivery history for each webhook.
Creates a new webhook for the specified project. The payload URL must be HTTPS. Optionally restrict to specific resource types; defaults to all types.
Returns the webhook with the given ID and its recent delivery history.
Updates the payload URL, active status, or subscribed types of the specified webhook.
Permanently deletes the webhook with the given ID.
Returns the current subscription status and list of subscribers for the specified recording.
Adds the authenticated user as a subscriber to the specified recording.
Bulk adds or removes subscribers from the specified recording using arrays of person IDs.
Removes the authenticated user as a subscriber from the specified recording.
